scope: Bounded static inspection of the interrupted scratch evidence-verifier integration, separate from product source and audit-lens read credit.
current_file_comparison: At this observed checkout, all 15 named target files matched their original whole-file identities and differed from the separately identified proposed overlay bytes. This is a point-in-time same-machine comparison, not a claim about later files.
finding: The draft Overlay.read deliberately loads affected content from the bundled scratch overlay, while Overlay.matches verifies that bundled successor against the recorded historical identity. The draft runner supplies a publication root but does not itself compare those 15 target files to the overlay. This is consistent with its stated scratch-only purpose; if reused as the sole live-checkout verifier after a future overlay, it would not establish that the live 15 files actually contain the reconstructed bytes.
integration_condition: Before adoption, separately bind all 15 actual current publication files to the intended successor whole-file hashes and preserve checks on unaffected files. Do not treat a scratch-overlay pass, matching assert counts, or a reversible source delta as proof of semantic equivalence. The reviewer has not reviewed all archive and helper dependencies or private-output behavior.
time_bound_external_check: The separate qualified-059 external check still fails against the changing working baseline because it asserts a captured historical whole-file identity. Preserve that failure and snapshot scope; do not weaken the historical assertion to make a live checkout pass.
attribution: The scratch adapter and original captures were authored by /root/hair_ops; /root separately inspected the two identified source files and compared the 15 captured target and overlay identities. The originating agent turn ended at a usage limit, so independent semantic review was not completed.
limits: Source-text and same-machine evidence-byte inspection only. No user extraction, product code, fixture, test, build, runtime probe or repair was executed. Old Git history and unread archives remain outside scope.
